note: STRUCTURAL-GATE PROOF (Phase B, real shipped float-rules.json via rules_path): a System Settings window — an app REMOVED from the allowlist in the aggressive narrowing — that reports a NON-RESIZABLE window (resizable:false; System Settings panes are commonly fixed-size). Even with its preference rule gone (float_verdict default 'on'), is_resizable fails ⇒ tileable FALSE. The hard directive: removing an app from the allowlist only tiles it IF it is resizable+standard; a non-resizable window STILL floats structurally — the gate, not the allowlist, keeps it out. If is_resizable were ever weakened, this goes red.
